invariant: A sequence candidate precedes class only when its commands consume the complete source successfully. Decorated arrows are recognized by command grammar, not raw class-marker substrings in labels or tokens.
causal_divergence: Raw o-- scores class even when part of a valid sequence command. Merely removing the score or increasing sequence weight does not establish full-source viability; parse_sequence currently silently ignores unknown commands.
planned_change: Add a bounded sequence viability diagnostic using actual sequence command consumption, preserving existing permissive public parsing. In dispatch prefer the successful sequence candidate only for the recognized decorated-message conflict; genuine nonsequence declarations/relations reject that candidate. Preserve all other factory scoring. If complete consumption cannot be established in owned code, retain dependency instead of broad redesign.
perturbation_axes: quoted labels/header bodies versus command tokens
